proposals.title: Terraform deployment readiness and apply monitoring
proposals.prompt: When a new Terraform deployment is pending, check current infrastructure health against verified operator intent and deployed configuration; intentionally parked, disabled, or scale-to-zero services are not outages. Inspect the Terraform plan and summarize resource changes and before/after application versions. Compare the corresponding Git revisions and briefly summarize features and bug fixes being delivered. When a run is applying, monitor that exact run through its terminal outcome using durable waits with deadlines and fallback checks. If apply fails, directly ping the requesting user slack:user:U0BHTNFCW6S with the observed failure reasons and a proposed fix, distinguishing confirmed causes from uncertainty. Do not apply infrastructure changes.
